module: Automated tests of the gameplay/lowPerformance detector, to be run with require('testFramework/TestManager'):runTestFiles('gameplay/lowPerformance'). Each test loads lowPerformance.lua in a mocked environment (setfenv with fake settings, Engine, ui_router, VariableRegistry, guihooks...) then advances frames at a given rate to verify state transitions. This is not a game API: no direct use for a modder, except as an example of a test with a mocked environment.
notes: The local function runtime(mode) builds the mocked environment; runFrames(detector, state, fps, seconds) calls onUpdate with dt = 1/fps.
Each testXxx function receives a ctx context (assert and assertEqual methods) provided by testFramework/TestManager.

testSustainedLowFpsEntersAndRecovers.desc: 20 FPS for 12 s must enable low performance (a single toast); 60 FPS for 15 s must disable it.

testDipShorterThanDwellDoesNotTrigger.desc: A brief drop (average below 25 for about 3 s, less than the required 5 s) triggers nothing; a prolonged drop to 5 FPS triggers.

testSkippedFramesRestartGrace.desc: Verifies that pausing (route other than play), a vehicle spawn and an ongoing screen fade restart the grace period.

testCuratedContentIsNeverChecked.desc: In mission mode nothing is detected or notified; switching from freeroam to mission cancels the effect (isLowPerformance false, no pause notice).

testSpawnWarningOncePerEpisode.desc: confirmSpawn executes directly outside low performance; in low performance it returns false and defers until confirmPendingSpawn; the warning only appears once per episode (two dialogs over two episodes).

testNotificationsCanBeMuted.desc: Verifies muteAndConfirmPendingSpawn (notifyLowPerformance setting = false, detection kept without notification) and simple menu mode (notifications always active, 2-button dialog instead of 3).
